text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (21.0%, 2.0%, 10.7x, 7.23, z 3.02, 71%, 18 returned, 0 of 5, 2 of 12). The cautious 'inconclusive' leaning and the partial-return caveat are well grounded in the tool outputs. But the headline 'Healthy panel' overstates the evidence, the summary is internally muddled, the examples are thin, and the next steps are generic, so an investigator would have to redo some work.","problems":["Headline says 'Healthy panel' as if established, yet 29% of 99215 claims were on patients with 2+ conditions and the card shows only complexity-based expectation; this framing is not supported and conflicts with the cautious 'inconclusive' leaning.","'only 18 of 30 charts returned' is grounded in the tool output, but the summary does not say the first request was rejected as SCOPE_UNCLEAR, nor that the deficiencies were ILLEGIBLE and MISSING_VISITS, which would help the investigator decide how to re-request.","Redundant sentences: '0 of 5 documented 99215 below billed' and '0 charts below the billed level among the 18' repeat each other; the note-signal line (problems 44%, late 6%, data 11%) is not interpreted, e.g. the 44% problems rate is not explained against peers.","Six numbers could not be matched by the script; some of the note-check percentages (44%, 6%, 11%) and 'No audit trail' do not appear on the card and only partly trace to the tool outputs shown.","Only two example claims are cited, both low-complexity 99215s, though 25 are listed; the 0-condition cases (e.g. J06.9, M54.50) are more telling than C0308215. No high-complexity contrast or documented-supported 99215 example is given.","Next step is generic ('request a targeted sample') and does not specify how many charts, what scope to state (given the earlier SCOPE_UNCLEAR rejection), or to request the missing 12 visits; it doesn't mention overpayment estimate or an audit trail request."]}
